hints.title: Subtree Remainder Invariant
hints.text: If a subtree's total sum is divisible by k, the edge connecting it to its parent can be severed without affecting divisibility of the rest of the tree.

hints.title: Post-Order Tree Traversal
hints.text: Use a depth-first search to compute the sum of values in each subtree modulo k from the leaves upwards.

hints.title: Cut Counting
hints.text: Whenever a subtree sum modulo k equals 0, increment the component count and pass 0 up to the parent.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all 2^(n-1) edge cutting subsets is exponential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary call stack and adjacency list.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply post-order DFS to greedily sever edges whenever subtree sum is divisible by k.
